title: Soda Firing—Semester Classes and Members
bring: bisqued cone 6 pots with wadding applied
pay_text: $45 per 1/2 cf of space; up to two allotments (1 cf) per firing
how_to_join: Must be a semester class student or independent study member; current students receive discount code via email
summary: Semester class students and independent study members can access soda firings year-round (except winter) by purchasing half-cubic-foot allotments. Each allotment costs $45 and holds about one pot or several smaller pieces; up to two allotments per firing. Bring bisqued cone 6 pots with wadding applied.
source_quote: Indigo Fire class students and independent study members will have access to soda firings throughout the year (except during winter hibernation)
evidence_sentence: Semester students and independent study members have year-round access to soda firings at the Moxie kiln.
